notes: Identity assessment: supplied text begins with the primary article download URL, Meta-Psychology 2021 vol. 5 MP.2020.2474, DOI 10.15626/MP.2020.2474, Article type: Replication Report; title and Chandrashekar, Cheng, Fong, Leung, Wong, Cheng, Feldman author list match the neutral replication reference. It contains the primary full report through p. 13 (methods, results, references), not an abstract or preregistration. No source PDF was supplied. Original side is an unassigned placeholder; no original source was read. Target ambiguity: neither the description nor study identifier 1 specifies Linda versus James. Table 2 p. 3 has an “and” and Unlikely target row for each profile. No assignment was made by row order or numeric matching. Printed candidate Linda: Cohen's d = 0.49 [0.31, 0.67] in Table 2, ds = 0.49 in p. 6 prose; t(431.26) = 5.51, p < .001 (one-sided; bound l). Printed candidate James: Cohen's d = -0.17 [-0.35, 0.00] in Table 2, ds = -0.17 in p. 6 prose; t(507.82) = −1.93, p = .973 (one-sided; bound e). These are paired within each candidate, with no metric conversions. Figure 1 p-values are explicitly two-tail and were not substituted. Candidate analytic N for either profile: 252 (“and”) + 258 (“unlikely”) = 510 participants; the procedure explicitly randomizes participants to one of four between-subject conditions and each participant answers both profiles. Thus profiles are repeated measurements and their Ns must not be added. Only the two mutually exclusive critical conditions are summed; likely and “and are” conditions are outside this contrast. Participants section p. 4 identifies four potentially excluded responses but says the main report focuses on the full sample. Exclusion evidence: We identified four responses to ... be excluded based on the exclusion criteria we rec- ... yet exclusions had no impact on the findings and so ... our main report focuses on the full sample. Per the field-scope rule, candidate N is retained for parent review rather than assigned globally while the profile-specific target remains ambiguous. Author verdict candidates, Table 2 note: Linda successful; James likely failed. No single row-specific verdict can be selected. All assigned field values remain null and confidence false pending target resolution.
